children: Arthur Hayes, co-founder of BitMEX, said the market must overcome a range of concerns at the start of a major bull run.
Cointelegraph reported on October 9 that Hayes said investor anxiety can persist even as a bull market begins, meaning the market must climb the so-called “Wall of Worry.”
He pointed to concerns surrounding artificial intelligence and cryptographic technology as one of the market’s main sources of anxiety in 2026.
Hayes described the presence of such concerns as a hallmark of the early stages of a major bull run.

title: Arthur Hayes Says Market Must Climb ‘Wall of Worry’ at Start of Major Bull Run
